t: What Solar Panel Degradation Database Is All About
title: What Solar Panel Degradation Database Is All About
description: Solar panels degrade slowly: ~0.5%/year median (NREL), so a 25-year warranty at 80% output is standard. Mechanisms: LID (light-induced, boron-oxygen), PID (potential-induced, voltage-driven leakage), snail trails, delamination, and soiling. Hot climates age faster; quality manufacturing ages slowest. Track degradation with normalized yield — the warranty is only as good as the monitoring. This database is the complete degradation record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
